summary: This directory manages the foundational infrastructure for translation operations, including prompt template initialization and verification of translation execution logic within the pipeline.
responsibilities: Manage and load translation prompt templates
Ensure accuracy of AI-driven translation tasks
relationships: Prompt templates provide the necessary instructions for the translation execution logic.
Translation execution processes are validated to ensure they correctly apply the loaded prompt templates.
The pipeline infrastructure integrates prompt management and execution verification to maintain translation quality.
designDecisions: Centralized asset management for prompt templates
Isolation of execution logic for unit testing
Collocation of testing and execution modules
